title: Operational telemetry
statement: The system shall export metrics and traces via OpenTelemetry covering request latency, commit latency, WAL fsync latency, transaction abort rate, leader changes and analytics-replica replication lag.
rationale: Operators need visibility, particularly of analytics lag since it carries no SLA.

acceptance_criteria.text: An OpenTelemetry collector receives each listed metric from every node at least every 15 seconds.
Analytics replication lag per shard is exported in seconds and in log entries.
